blocks.text: NP-Complete masle NP maslon ka ek khaas hissa (subset) hain: yeh NP mein bhi hain aur NP ke sab se mushkil maslon jitne mushkil bhi hain. Is ka matlab hai ke yeh masle khaas taur par mushkil hain, aur agar aap kisi ek NP-Complete masle ko efficiently hal kar lein to NP ke tamam masle efficiently hal kar sakte hain.
Misal: NP-Complete masle ki mashhoor misal Knapsack Problem hai.

Knapsack Problem mein aap ke paas ek knapsack (thaila) hai jis ki zyada se zyada wazan uthane ki had (capacity) tay hai, aur kuch cheezein (items) hain; har cheez ka apna wazan aur apni qeemat (value) hai. Maqsad cheezon ka woh mel (combination) dhoondna hai jo sab se zyada qeemti ho aur thaile ki wazan ki had se zyada na ho.

items: Verification is Easy (jaanchna aasan): agar aap ko cheezon ka set aur ek pesh kiya gaya hal diya jaye to aap jaldi check kar sakte hain ke kul wazan had ke andar hai aur kul qeemat sahi hai.
Solving the Problem is Hard (hal karna mushkil): wazan ki had mein reh kar sab se zyada qeemat dene wala behtareen (optimal) mel dhoondna mushkil hai, khaas taur par jab cheezon ki ginti barhti hai.

NP-Completeness: Knapsack Problem NP-Complete hai kyun ke yeh NP mein bhi hai (hal jaldi verify hota hai) aur NP ke sab se mushkil maslon jitna mushkil bhi hai. Agar Knapsack Problem efficiently hal ho jaye to tamam NP masle efficiently hal ho sakte hain.

blocks.text: Knapsack Problem NP-Complete kyun hai, yeh samjhane ke liye:

items: Small Instances (chhote cases): kam cheezon ke liye tamam mumkin mel check kar ke behtareen hal dhoondna mumkin ho sakta hai.

Larger Instances (bare cases): cheezein barhne par mumkin mel ki ginti exponentially barhti hai (n cheezon ke 2ⁿ mel), is liye brute force (har mel aazmane) se hal karna practically na-mumkin ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Venn diagram: oopar bara daira NP-Hard neeche wale daire NP par chadha hua hai; dono ka common (saanjha) hissa NP-Complete hai. NP ke andar neeche chhota oval (ande jaisa) daira P hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P poora NP ke andar hai: jo masla jaldi hal ho sakta hai us ka jawab jaldi jaancha bhi ja sakta hai. NP-Complete woh hissa hai jo NP mein bhi hai aur NP-Hard mein bhi, jaise Knapsack Problem. NP-Hard ka baqi hissa NP se bahar hai: woh masle kam az kam NP-Complete jitne mushkil hain magar zaroori nahi ke un ka jawab jaldi jaancha ja sake.

Figure 3.4 complexity classes P, NP, NP-hard aur NP-complete ka Venn diagram dikhati hai. Yeh in classes ke aapas ka taalluq tasveer ki shakal mein dikhati hai: kuch masle efficiently hal ho jate hain, jabke kuch computational theory ke liye bari mushkil hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya P aur NP barabar hain (P = NP?), yeh computer science ke sab se ahem ab tak hal na hone wale sawalon mein se hai. Is ke cryptography (khufia code ka ilm), algorithm design aur computational complexity ki samajh par bare implications (asar) hain.

blocks.prompt: Complexity classes P, NP, NP-hard aur NP-complete aur masle ki mushkil samajhne mein un ki ahmiyat par baat kijiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: P: polynomial time mein hal (sorting). NP: diya gaya hal polynomial time mein jaancha ja sake (Sudoku); P, NP ke andar hai. NP-hard: kam az kam har NP masle jitna mushkil, aur zaroori nahi ke NP mein ho (TSP). NP-complete: NP ke woh masle jo NP-hard bhi hain (Knapsack). Yeh classes batati hain ke efficient aur sahi algorithm ki umeed rakhein ya nahi: P maslon ke liye sahi algorithms; NP-hard aur NP-complete ke liye aksar approximate (andaze wale) hal, heuristics ya chhote inputs. Agar P = NP saabit ho jaye to tamam NP masle efficiently hal ho sakenge, jis ka asar cryptography par parega.

items: NP-complete: NP mein bhi aur NP-hard bhi (Knapsack); ek ka efficient hal tamam NP masle hal kar dega.
Venn diagram: P, NP ke andar; NP-complete wahan jahan NP aur NP-hard milte hain; P = NP? abhi tak hal nahi hua.
